label: Level shifters
subgoals: Show that a low-voltage high fails to turn off a high-supply pMOS
Use a cross-coupled pair on the high supply to restore full swing
Mark the cell and its per-pin supplies in Liberty

label: Isolation and always-on cells
subgoals: Clamp a powered-down domain's outputs with an isolation enable
Power the isolation cell from a supply that stays on
Route surviving signals through always-on buffers with secondary supply pins

label: Retention flops and power-intent checking
subgoals: Save state into an always-on shadow latch before power-down
Restore it after power-up and retain only state worth keeping
Check crossings and supply connections against the power-intent file
